description: Open Data Armenia: earthquake hazard datasets is a collection of datasets listed in Open Data Armenia, an open data portal (CKAN) run by a civil-society initiative, published or maintained by Open Data Armenia. Coverage: Open Data Armenia. The listing groups 3 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about earthquake hazard; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Earthquakes from Antiquity to the 12th Century; Global Significant Earthquake Database, 2150 B.C. to present; 1988 Spitak Earthquake Database. Formats seen: PDF, TSV. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution, Other (Open). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-opendata-am.
